title: Centralized Logging
description: Real application log streams collected by Grafana Alloy from Docker and stored in Grafana Loki (Phase 2B.2) — not synthetic log lines. Known limitation, shown here rather than hidden: checkout-service and inventory-service currently only log at container startup (no per-request access logging exists in either yet), while payment-service and notification-service log per request. There is no severity filter on this dashboard: Loki's automatic detected_level heuristic only reliably classifies checkout-service (Spring Boot "INFO "/"WARN " prefixes) and payment-service (Uvicorn "INFO:" prefix) — it reports "unknown" for inventory-service (plain Go log output with no level prefix) and notification-service (pino JSON with a numeric level field), confirmed empirically, so a severity filter would silently misrepresent half the services. No log line in any of the four services currently contains a trace ID or span ID, so logs and traces are not correlated here or anywhere else in this platform — that is not invented or implied by this dashboard.

panels.title: Log Line Rate by Service
panels.description: sum by (service) (rate({service=~"$log_service"}[$__interval])) — log lines/sec ingested per service, using LogQL's rate() (entries per second over the window). Not count_over_time(), which returns a raw count per window rather than a rate, and is not directly comparable across different zoom levels/interval widths. checkout-service and inventory-service are expected to show a single brief spike at container start, then nothing — that is correct behavior for this codebase today, not missing data collection.

panels.title: Application Log Stream
panels.description: {service=~"$log_service"} — real, raw log lines exactly as emitted by each service's own stdout/stderr and shipped by Alloy, with Loki's original ingestion timestamp. No reformatting, no injected fields.
